mappings.coverage: complete own-state PAR loader with original downstream record/resolver composition and explicit runtime services
mappings.qualification: Complete own-state 0x64c300 PAR loader over valid prepared records, instances, scene table and buffered streams; activation 0x64ae50, selection 0x644000 and managed asset resolution remain explicit services. All 112 authored PAR files are unchanged and fed completely as transport inputs; original record decoder 0x64ba10, resolver 0x64b020, buffered readers and sprite/particle/audio lookup bodies execute unchanged in native comparison. Asset contexts contain empty particle registry, 1,600 NULL audio name pointers and scene sprite tables with zero records; no loaded-asset lookup or runtime activation/nearest-selection implementation is claimed. The 200 retained cases cover all versions 1..16 in both byte orders, low-byte mode dispatch, bank selection, record/instance capacity, full scene table, failed/occupied opens, empty record names, negative counts, missing instance names and runtime callback mutation order. Captured 843,768-byte region image, asset argument SHA and counts, runtime service trace, transport trace and state, and raw EAX are compared for every case. Discarded overflow records use a 376-byte temporary outside captured regions; discarded bytes are not a stack-layout reconstruction. Finite/signed-zero instance coordinates are covered; general x87 exceptional-value conversion is not claimed. Source and portable harness compile as a library; managed fixture replay is pending, with no generated executable launch.
